before:
'family',private.category_of_event(q.event_type)
  ) order by q.created_at desc,q.id desc),'[]'::jsonb) into v_items

order by nd.created_at,nd.id limit 1
  ) d on true;
after:
order by nd.created_at,nd.id limit 1
  ) d on true
  -- INBOX-NASLOV (owner 2026-10-08): taskTitle = the title of the task (need) the event is about, or null. NEED: that need;
  -- RESPONSE: the need of that application; AGREEMENT: the need of that Dogovor. Only for the requester of that need, the
  -- worker of that application, a party of that Dogovor or, for a NEED event, the worker it offered the task to
  -- (OPPORTUNITY_AVAILABLE: its body already names the task) or who applied to it. Null for every other entity kind, a missing
  -- row, a task an account closure erased (private.closure_redaction_patch_v5 writes 'Obrisan zadatak' and 'OBRISANO') and
  -- anyone without that right. The title only: no address, no other field. Primary-key lookups for at most p_limit+1 rows.
  left join lateral (
    select x.title as task_title from (
      select n.title,n.category from public.needs n
      where q.entity_type='NEED' and n.id=q.entity_id
        and (n.requester_account_id=v_uid or q.event_type='OPPORTUNITY_AVAILABLE'
          or exists(select 1 from public.marketplace_responses mine where mine.need_id=n.id and mine.worker_account_id=v_uid))
      union all
      select n.title,n.category from public.marketplace_responses r join public.needs n on n.id=r.need_id
      where q.entity_type='RESPONSE' and r.id=q.entity_id and (r.worker_account_id=v_uid or n.requester_account_id=v_uid)
      union all
      select n.title,n.category from public.agreements a join public.needs n on n.id=a.need_id
      where q.entity_type='AGREEMENT' and a.id=q.entity_id and v_uid in (a.requester_account_id,a.worker_account_id)
    ) x
    where x.category<>'OBRISANO' and x.title<>'Obrisan zadatak'
    limit 1
  ) t on true;
